meta_description: Phoenix Painting and Plastering in Newcastle delivers expert interior and exterior painting, plastering, and decorating. Free quotes, reliable service.
hero_eyebrow: Qualified Painter & Plasterer — Free Quotes & No Obligation
hero_subhead: From fresh interior walls to exterior weatherproofing, we deliver flawless finishes on time and within budget.
services_heading: Complete Painting & Plastering Services Across Newcastle
services_subhead: Whether you need interior redecoration, exterior protection, or skilled plastering work, we handle every detail with care.

services.title: Interior Painting & Decorating
services.desc: Transform your living spaces with expert interior painting. We prep, prime, and finish to a high standard — from feature walls to full room makeovers.

services.title: Exterior Painting & Weatherproofing
services.desc: Protect and refresh your property's exterior. We use quality exterior paints that withstand Newcastle's weather, ensuring long-lasting colour and protection.

services.title: Plastering & Wall Repair
services.desc: Expert plastering for new walls, repairs, and re-skimming. We leave surfaces smooth and ready for paint or wallpaper — no cracks, no shortcuts.

services.title: Artexing & Ceiling Work
services.desc: Whether refreshing dated ceilings or creating textured finishes, we deliver professional results. We also remove or repair existing Artex safely.

services.title: Woodwork & Joinery Painting
services.desc: Skirting boards, doors, windows, and fitted furniture deserve the same care as walls. We sand, undercoat, and finish to a showroom standard.

services.title: Commercial Painting & Redecorating
services.desc: From shop fronts to office spaces, we work around your schedule to minimise disruption. Fast, professional, and completed to brief.

about_pullquote: We don't cut corners — every wall gets the prep it deserves.
about_para_1: Phoenix Painting and Plastering was founded on a simple idea: do the job right, first time. With over 12 years of hands-on experience across Newcastle and the North East, we've built our reputation on honest pricing and meticulous workmanship. From Victorian terraces to modern new-builds, we've painted and plastered thousands of properties.
about_para_2: Our customers come back because we listen, we show up on time, and we leave the site clean. We don't oversell or overcomplicate — you get a free quote, a clear timescale, and a finish you'll be proud of. Whether it's a small bedroom refresh or a full commercial project, we treat every job with the same care.
reviews_heading: What Newcastle Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had the entire downstairs redecorated — interior walls, doors, and skirting. The lads were prompt, tidy, and got it done faster than I expected. Really pleased with the finish. Won't hesitate to call them again.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Called for a quote on plastering work after damp repairs. Got a fair price and they started within a week. The walls are perfectly smooth now, ready for wallpaper. Professional outfit, no mess left behind.
reviews.author: Jennifer P.

reviews.text: Exterior needed a fresh coat after years of weathering. These guys came out, assessed the work properly, and gave me a realistic quote. Finished on schedule and it looks brilliant. Definitely value for money.
reviews.author: David M.
